_about: The two STK2 AK-74s of pack weapons-stk2 (docs/notes/weapons-stk2.md) wear a camouflage and a decal as the AK-74M does (weapon-camo-1 and weapon-decals-1 for them): parameters/camo_available and a data table with camo_scale 4.0 (client patch 44; their _aoac masks are pack weapons-stk2-camo, from scripts/weapons-stk2/camo.tsv), parameters/decal_available and an empty data/decals (client patch 47).
